description: This file defines a PHP class GetSystemHealthController that handles HTTP GET requests to '/system/health'. It checks system health components such as filesystem directory writability, database server connectivity, and Redis server reachability, returning this information as an API response.

classes.name: GetSystemHealthController
classes.description: Controller class handling system health check requests, returning status of filesystem, database, and Redis server.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for filesystem path, directory checking, MySQL, and Redis servers.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the incoming request, returning health status information.

methods.name: isRedisServerReachable
methods.description: Checks if Redis server is reachable by issuing a ping, with error handling.
